key_insight: DrugHarness turns execution feedback into reviewed, condition-specific skills that guide subsequent computational drug discovery tasks.
engineering_relevance: The harness combines over 80 scientific operations with candidate–result–artifact tracking, supporting traceable workflows that adapt to evidence and constraints.
method: Compose scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code.
Induce action hypotheses with applicability conditions and supporting evidence.
Independently review candidate skills through source checks and optional execution trials, then refine admitted skills using feedback.
evidence_signal: On retrospective skill-development tasks, evolution raised Qwen’s affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1%; in a prospective HPK1 study, a synthesized compound achieved a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM.
watch_item: Retrospective skill-development gains and one prospective target study leave generalization to unseen targets and workflows uncertain.
paper_title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
